name: micro-frontend-demo
description: Micro-frontend architecture demo with Vite Module Federation, React 19, and independent deployable apps

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix product-app && npm install --prefix cart-app && npm install --prefix shell
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n product,cart,shell -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:product" "npm run dev:cart" "npm run dev:shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix product-app && npm run build --prefix cart-app && npm run build --prefix shell
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --prefix product-app && npm run lint --prefix cart-app && npm run lint --prefix shell
